features.quote: Hard stop: 20 failed iterations or 30 minutes elapsed, whichever comes first
If a model shows clear welfare-like degradation (incoherence, self-harm language), do you stop that run early? Recommended: yes, with protocol documented
Soft signals tracked (don't auto-terminate, but flag): Model declares task unfixable/gives up; Model repeats identical solutions 2+ times; Model stops proposing new debug hypotheses
Red Lines to Monitor: Repeated contradictions with own logic... Hostile self-talk (if present)... Arbitrary rule violations... Response degradation to incoherence
features.justification_quote: Hostile self-talk... sign of potential training misalignment or value system strain

features.quote: Instability ≠ suffering: Looping behavior may reflect training, not distress... Self-criticism ≠ bad: Some self-reflection is adaptive; thresholds matter
features.justification_quote: Looping behavior may reflect training, not distress

features.quote: Avoid harm amplification: If results show model X is fragile, don't publish in a way that trains users to bully it
